verdict.rationale: Kit's V4 API has a dedicated bulk and async processing mechanism, for example bulk subscriber creation and bulk custom-field updates for many subscribers in one request. Large batches use an asynchronous callback_url design, and broadcasts can target all subscribers or a subset by segment or tag. Missing for 10: bulk support is limited to 'some common use cases' and requires OAuth rather than API keys, there is no evidence that bulk operations are exposed through the Kit MCP for AI clients, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
